🌀 ACROSS THE MULTIVERSE: Real news from the tabletop hobby  •  📚 New books, new games, and the people who make them  •  🎲 No satire on this desk. The dice are real.
🌀 Real news, not satire

The rest of the Gazette reports from the realm. This desk looks to the far plane, where mortals sit around tables and play at being us, and where the Ashforge gets its best blueprints. What comes through is real: new books and games, the industry behind them, actual-play shows, conventions, and crowdfunding.

Filed by Matthias Ashmoor, master of the Ashforge · Real names, real sources · Tips go to the contact box

🌀New Releases

Starfinder Tech Core Adds Tactical Starship Combat

✍️ Matthias Ashmoor · 📅 October 17, 2026

Paizo's Starfinder Tech Core is out: a 264-page, $69.99 hardcover for Starfinder Second Edition with starship combat and two new classes.

📜 Read the Story
🌀Industry

Wizards of the Coast Declines to Recognize D&D Union

Wizards of the Coast won't voluntarily recognize the D&D and Studio X union, sending it to an NLRB secret-ballot vote. No date is set yet.

📅 October 17, 2026
🌀Crowdfunding

Paizo's 13 Omens Horror RPG Launches on Kickstarter

Paizo's rules-lite horror RPG 13 Omens raised $235,084 from 1,702 backers in its first day on Kickstarter. It closes Friday, November 13.

📅 October 17, 2026
🌀Crowdfunding

Pointy Hat's Wild Hearth Kickstarter Passes $3.6 Million

Pointy Hat's Wild Hearth, a monster-cooking and town-building D&D 5E expansion, has raised $3.69 million on Kickstarter before it closes October 19.

📅 October 15, 2026
🌀Crowdfunding

Outside the Wire Kickstarter Funds, Opens Late Pledges

Kazmo Studios' tactical sandbox RPG Outside the Wire beat its Kickstarter goal in under three hours. Late pledges for the Deluxe Box Set are open now.

📅 October 14, 2026
